# opnsense_telegraf_key (Data Source)

Global tags added to every Telegraf metric (**Services ▸ Telegraf ▸ Tags**, plugin `os-telegraf`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the Telegraf global tag.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) This will enable or disable the key mapping.
- `name` (String) Set the name of this mapping.
- `value` (String) Set the value of the defined key.
